svg.title: Private LLM inference on EKS: AWS architecture
svg.text: Private LLM inference on EKS: AWS architecture
us-east-1 · EKS 1.35 · vLLM on one NVIDIA A10G · everything inside one private VPC (no internet gateway, no NAT, no public ingress)
Session Manager: shell on the bastion
VPC 10.20.0.0/16 (dedicated) · NO internet gateway · NO NAT gateway · no public ingress
no inbound rules, no SSH key
EKS managed node group: system (2 x t4g.small Spot, arm64, gp3 20 GB)
No PVCs: emptyDir only. Prometheus keeps 6 h of data.
Nodes get no AWS credentials from IMDS (hop limit 1).
Node volumes: gp3, encrypted with the customer-managed KMS key.
EKS node group: gpu (g5.xlarge On-Demand, A10G 24 GB, gp3 60 GB, tainted)
init container: aws s3 sync -> emptyDir
service account with IRSA (S3 read only)
AL2023 NVIDIA AMI: driver + container toolkit preinstalled.
Only GPU pods tolerate the taint, so they alone land here.
GPU capacity: Spot had none (UnfulfillableCapacity), so On-Demand.
Costs about $1.01/hr; the node group is a Terraform toggle.
scheme internal, target-type ip (nodes in 1c and 1d)
reachable ONLY from inside the VPC
ENIs in both subnets; reached from the bastion on 443
access entries: admin role + bastion role
control-plane logs OFF by default (toggle, CloudWatch cost)
foundation: VPC, S3 gateway endpoint, ECR, buckets
platform: endpoints, EKS, nodes, bastion, IRSA
Note: cost and safety (toggles, default off)
GPU nodes (Spot / On-Demand), EKS audit logs
existing KMS key referenced by ARN only
tags on everything: Project, Environment, Owner
